text: Here's a CRM I built for another lender, set up the way Excel Capital would use it.
Every morning starts on Today. At the top: repayments that didn't come in, straight from your repayments app, with the reason.
Click See repayments, and you get every collection: what came in, and what failed.
Below that: follow-ups, new applications from your website and your brokers, and renewals that are ready.
Click Deals. Every application moves left to right, from new to funded.
When a broker sends one in, type the business name. If another broker sent it first, it tells you.
Before a deal funds, click Send bank link. The business approves repayments in their own bank.
When they do, the checklist ticks itself. Click Mark funded.
Repayments start on their own, and every one shows up on the deal.
Once a business has paid back half, it's ready to renew.
One place for every deal, from first enquiry to last repayment.
